[size=6]Introduce[/size]

[size=3]This mod allows you to speed up the speed at which the game responds to player input. Planting crops and placing items is often annoying when you have speed buff in the game. Take planting crops for example, when you don't have speed buff, holding down the left or right mouse button and moving the player can easily plant a row. But when you have speed buff, it often leads to missing a few rows, and this mod solves that problem.[/size]

[/size]
